findings.title: Archive readiness pre-prepare execution ownership is unproven
facts: 063 correctly requires correction-capable archive readiness to finish before structural prepared materialization.
Current invokeSingleAction(...) establishes prepared before Run-context validation, canonical Guidance resolution, ActionPackage formation, and host callback execution.
The expected implementation surface is primarily archive/bootstrap Guidance and tests, while Explore claims Core/Policy mutation is unnecessary.
findings.requiredConvergence: Prove an existing owned pre-invocation mechanism that can execute the exact readiness/self-check before structural prepare and explain how trusted check/HOW identity is obtained, or explicitly surface the smallest real host/Core seam or separate semantic boundary required by proof. Do not claim Guidance-only sufficiency until this is closed.

findings.title: Canonical Explore retains revision chronology
facts: explore.md narrates Reviewer pre-scope verdict/corrections, Owner correction, and execution-trigger chronology.
Current bootstrap/product Explore convergence discipline requires canonical Explore to express current rationale rather than revision diary sections.
findings.requiredConvergence: Rewrite chronology-bearing passages into present-tense facts/current rationale; preserve exact authority and revision chronology only in the Run chain.
